hints.title: Augmented State Modeling
hints.text: Incorporate the set of collected keys directly into each position state.

hints.title: Bitmask Inventory Representation
hints.text: Represent the inventory of collected keys using an integer bitmask up to 2 raised to key count.

hints.title: Lock Access Validation
hints.text: Traverse neighbors in four directions, verifying that any encountered lock has its corresponding key bit enabled in the current bitmask.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: K: total number of distinct keys (at most 6)
complexity.notes: Breadth-first search over states (row, col, collected_keys_mask).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Standard 2D grid searches without tracking key states cannot revisit cells legitimately.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Visited state array scales exponentially with the number of keys (2^K <= 64).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Model search states with bitmasks and apply shortest path exploration.
